tasks.label: CMake: Build AR MainBoard Release
tasks.detail: Build the AR Code MainBoard with the Release CMake preset and GNU STM32 14.3.1+st.2.

tasks.label: Flash AR MainBoard via ST-LINK
tasks.detail: Flash and verify the Release MainBoard ELF over ST-LINK/SWD, then reset. Keep motor power disconnected and do not try a powered test until hardware has been cleared.

tasks.label: Build + Flash AR MainBoard (Release)
tasks.detail: Build the Release AR MainBoard image, then flash and reset the target via ST-LINK.
